Name: Luma Shorts
Description: Short form content app for Windows 10.

Name: Fresh Paint
Description: Unleash your inner creative with Fresh Paint - the ultimate canvas for your big ideas.

Name: VLC UWP
Description: VLC is the ultimate media player, ported to the Windows Universal Platform. ⚠ ⚠ Beware! This VLC does not feature all the features of the classic VLC! It does not support DVD or Blurays! Use the desktop version instead! ⚠⚠

Name: BrowserQuest
Description: BrowserQuest is a small multiplayer game inviting you to explore a world of adventure from your Windows device.

Name: Paint 3D
Description: Whether you’re an artist or just want to try out some doodles–Paint 3D makes it easy to unleash your creativity and bring your ideas to life. Classic Paint has been reimagined, with an updated look and feel and a ton of new brushes and tools. And now, create in every dimension. Make 2D masterpieces

Name: Minecraft for Windows
Description: Explore randomly generated worlds and build amazing things from the simplest of homes to the grandest of castles. Play in creative mode with unlimited resources or mine deep into the world in survival mode, crafting weapons and armor to fend off the dangerous mobs.

Name: Hill Climb Racing
Description: One of the most addictive and entertaining physics based driving game ever made! And it's free! Meet Newton Bill, the young aspiring uphill racer. He is about to embark on a journey that takes him to where no ride has ever been before. With little respect to the laws of physics

Name: MSN Weather
Description: Check accurate forecast, weather details, forecast for the past year and more with MSN Weather app. It even shows the live tile for your home city, so you don't have to open the app everytime. Patched with newRetiled, credit to migbrunluz. App is for 1511+.
